messages:
nova: opened a PR to modernize the Quickstart + onboarding flow. moving examples to SDK8 async, clarifying auth, and fixing a couple of portability nits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1188
grant: nice. can you summarize the snippet changes so reviewers know where to focus?
nova: sure: (1) sync -> async python sample, (2) node top-level await with a CommonJS fallback, (3) replace `sed -i` with cross-platform node/python one-liners, (4) canonicalize curl header to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`, (5) Dockerfile port and env clarifications, (6) short ephemeral-key example + KMS pointer.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #1188: docs build, linkcheck, snippet-tests are running.
keisha: quick note: curl header still lowercased in one place, and the Dockerfile EXPOSE was 3000 but the app listens on 8080. caught it in local dry run.
nova: fixing both now. thanks. switching EXPOSE to 8080 and updating the curl snippet.
marc: portability warning: snippet-tests often fail on mac runners with `sed -i`. prefer `python -c` or `node -e` replacements. we should include both options and label them.
nova: good call. i'll include both a node one-liner and a python one-liner with comments: e.g. `node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('cfg', fs.readFileSync('cfg.tpl','utf8').replace('PLACEHOLDER', process.env.RW_API_KEY||''))"` and `python3 - <<'PY'
import os,sys
open('cfg','w').write(open('cfg.tpl').read().replace('PLACEHOLDER', os.getenv('RW_API_KEY','')))
PY`
grant: also add a sentence about ephemeral keys TTL and link to /security/kms so enterprise folks know where to look for rotation/HSM.
keisha: snippet-tests failed on macos: entrypoint.sh triggered shellcheck warning because it used an unguarded var. logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1188/snippet-log.
marc: fix is simple: use `${RW_API_KEY:-}` or `if [ -n "${RW_API_KEY:-}" ]` guards. please push the fix.
nova: patched entrypoint.sh, added `${VAR:-}` guard, and added a tiny troubleshooting FAQ with two bullets: missing header vs expired/ephemeral token.
ci-bot: snippet-tests retriggered and passed except linkcheck flagged a redirect from /integrations/kms -> /security/kms.
marc: update to canonical path and re-run.
nova: updated links to canonical /security/kms and added a one-line note: "For automated rotation in production, integrate your KMS and use env-var reloaders (systemd/k8s) to swap keys without downtime."
grant: quick UX nit: heading uses "first deploy" — change to "first deployment" to match style guide.
keisha: left one small comment on the Node sample: either show `package.json` "type":"module" or use an async IIFE for CommonJS users. new devs get confused.
nova: added an async IIFE fallback and a one-liner note about module type. pushed updates.
ci-bot: all checks green for PR #1188. mergeable.
marc: approved from docs side. small request: can we add a short example showing ephemeral key fetch? one line like `export RW_API_KEY=$(curl -s \"https://auth.redwood/api/ephemeral?scope=generate\")` so folks see the shape.
nova: added ephemeral example and shortened the blurb to one sentence + example. kept KMS pointer for enterprise.
gr...: i'll sanity-check staging after the deploy. thanks for handling the sed/portable snippets.
ci-bot: PR #1188 merged and site deploy to staging started.
marc: ran through the staging quickstart, Docker/devcontainer notes OK, ephemeral example works locally. left a tiny wording tweak on staging branch for clarity.
keisha: verified troubleshooting FAQ covers the common auth tickets we've seen. LGTM.
gr...: merging final micro-fix to main and closing. thanks team :tada:
nova: awesome — thanks everyone for the quick reviews. closing thread.
